stem_book: Find the most general solutions for 2^(sin x) + 2^(cos x) = 2^(1 − 1/√2).
reason: Manifest stem lost the exponents (read '2 sin x + 2 cos x = 2 1 − 1/√2'); restored as printed.
work: AM ≥ GM: 2^(sin x) + 2^(cos x) ≥ 2·2^((sin x + cos x)/2) ≥ 2·2^(−√2/2) = 2^(1 − 1/√2), equality iff sin x = cos x = −1/√2 ⇒ x = 2nπ + 5π/4
